# eckWMS — agent-native, offline-first WMS/RMA node (open core)

> Rust node binary: warehouse/repair/field-service management with embedded
> SurrealDB, decentralized merkle-mesh sync, built-in POS, and an MCP surface
> that treats AI agents as first-class users behind a deterministic PII
> pseudonymization layer. AGPL-3.0. This documentation set is machine-first:
> written to be consumed by agents, not marketed to humans.

Start here, in order:

## Docs (machine-first)
- [Identity & component map](docs/machine/00-identity.md): what this is, design commitments, honest non-claims
- [Mesh sync protocol](docs/machine/20-mesh-sync.md): content-hash merkle, vclocks, blind-conduit file delivery, invariants
- [PII pseudonymization](docs/machine/30-pprl.md): token grammar, guarantees, threat model
- [MCP tool catalog](docs/machine/40-mcp-tools.md): every tool with JSON schema, tier gates, PII behavior
- [HTTP surface](docs/machine/45-http-surface.md): route inventory with auth gates
- [AI pipeline](docs/machine/50-ai-pipeline.md): summarization state machine, batch mode, embeddings
- [Config matrix](docs/machine/60-config-matrix.md): every env var, defaults, minimal-env recipes
- [Integration quickstart](docs/machine/70-integration.md): connect an MCP agent in minutes
- [Open-core boundary](docs/machine/80-boundaries.md): exactly what is standalone vs commercial
